title: showcase: the "Recalculate Estimate" / "Recalculate Selection" api actions answer 500 — recalc-endpoint.ts calls ctx.ql.update with no execution context, which the security layer refuses as a principal-less write
body:
Filing-gate category ① (product defect, named landing point) and ③ — the maintainer's order in the dispatching session, verbatim: 「测试遇到的问题，可以提交issue」.

QA-source: #23104 · records-forms.action-location-matrix · A2

**Reader who acts:** the seat that owns `examples/app-showcase` (lane per triage). **Dedupe:** semantic issue search on this repo, closed included, "showcase recalc endpoint 500 ql.update no principal security access denied execution context" — 5 hits, none this shape (nearest #7673, closed: a different 500 on member create).

## Environment

objectstack `36b2889c` with the console built from objectui `1fb1ced36243` (the pin hop of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23104, since landed as `f451a5964`), stock `examples/app-showcase`, `--seed-admin`, admin persona. Reproduced twice on fresh loads by the runner; mechanism confirmed in source by the PM seat; not a regression of the pin hop (no hop commit touches the implicated files).

## Reproduction

1. Open any task record: `/_console/apps/showcase_app/showcase_task/record/ID`.
2. Header ⋯ (More actions) → "Recalculate Selection" (or "Recalculate Estimate") → confirm Run.
3. Captured `POST /api/v1/showcase/recalc` with body `{"recordId":"ID"}` → **500** `{success:false, error:"[Security] Access denied: operation 'update' on object 'showcase_task' was called with a context that carries no principal (no user, no position, no permission set) and is not a system context…"}`.
4. `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task/ID` → `estimate_hours` unchanged (40 → 40). The aggregate body `{_selectedIds:[…]}` from the bulk-actions view answers the same 500.

**Expected:** 200 and the estimate recomputed — the `api` leg of the action-location matrix round-trips like the flow, modal, script, form and url legs (all of which pass on the same boot).

## Mechanism (objectstack `main`)

`examples/app-showcase/src/system/server/recalc-endpoint.ts` writes with `ctx.ql.update('showcase_task', {...}, { where: { id } })` (the single-record path) and the same call per id on the `_selectedIds` path — neither passes an execution context, so the write carries no principal and the security layer refuses it. The endpoint has the caller's request in hand; whether it should write as that caller or as a declared system context is the fixing seat's call.
